DOMINANT_RATE_THRESHOLD.promotion_authority: TL ACTION 2026-06-15 + Manager approval (Elevate v0.4 and Lock Prereg v0.3)
DOMINANT_RATE_THRESHOLD.definition_text: A failure category is 'dominant' when its rate is >= 0.25 over the pre-declared analysis unit (definition v0.4 §11).
DOMINANT_RATE_THRESHOLD.rationale: Closes the v0.3-prior scorer-code-only provenance gap CS raised in the value-lock-patch review. The 0.25 threshold is now declared with the failure signatures it governs (definition R11), qualified by a pre-declared analysis unit (R11), not buried in scorer code. The scorer code still imports this constant from here for shared use; the code is the implementation, the definition is the source of truth.
